summary: L-4 tower on Tipsoo Butte, Willamette NF, Lane County OR; register dates it 1934, removed or burned 1965-66. No source describes the site today.

facts.design: L-4 tower, per the register and firelookout.com; a 1933 report describes a lookout house on a 30-foot tower
facts.status_note: Removed in 1966 per the register; destroyed in 1966 per firelookout.com; burned in 1965 per the Oregon Lookouts page
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Willamette National Forest

events.note: Lookout house under construction in August 1933; a September 1933 report describes a crew building it on a 30-foot tower
Elden Pepiot reported stationed at the mountain in August 1933, while the lookout house was going up
Register and firelookout.com date the L-4 tower to 1934, about a mile and a half northwest of the summit
October 1949 notice says Paul B. Means and daughter Charlotte held a lookout post there; years not given
Oregon Lookouts page says the lookout burned in 1965; the other sources give 1966
Register says the tower was removed in 1966
firelookout.com says the tower was destroyed in 1966
Registered May 14, 2011 as US 997, OR 355; nominated by Ray Kresek

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 1934 as the build year; the 1933 newspaper items show construction already under way. Both dates are reported in the story rather than picking one.

notes_for_editor: Fate conflict: removed 1966 (register), destroyed 1966 (firelookout.com), burned 1965 (Oregon Lookouts). Build year 1934 in two sources vs construction reported in 1933. The 9.1 m height comes from the 1933 '30-foot tower' report, not a measured figure. Access level is not stated in any source, so access is omitted. No source describes the site today. The Oregon Lookouts page quotes 1933 and 1949 newspapers; those originals were not read. A 1960 photo is credited to the Ron Kemnow collection on the register page, but no image URL was captured, so no photo is recorded.
